description: Phase 1.8 data-quality dashboard: bar coverage, freshness, and structural integrity of market_data.bars (canonical writer: core_trading/data/storage.py; quality gate: core_trading/data/quality.py via python -m core_trading.data.ingest).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS bars FROM market_data.bars FINAL
SELECT uniqExact(symbol) AS symbols FROM market_data.bars

panels.title: History span (days, 1d bars)

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('day', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS span_days FROM market_data.bars WHERE resolution = '1d'

panels.description: Phase 1 DOD requires >= 5 years (1825 days) of daily history.

panels.title: Structural violations (must be 0)

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(high < low) AS high_lt_low, countIf(volume < 0) AS negative_volume, countIf(close = 0) AS zero_close FROM market_data.bars FINAL

panels.description: Mirrors the error-severity checks in core_trading/data/quality.py: high < low, negative volume, zero closes.

panels.title: Unmerged duplicate rows

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() - uniqExact(symbol, resolution, timestamp) AS pending_dups FROM market_data.bars

panels.description: Physical duplicates awaiting ReplacingMergeTree merge. Non-zero is normal shortly after re-ingestion; persistently growing values are not.

panels.title: Symbols with a 1d bar per day (coverage)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time, uniqExact(symbol) AS symbols FROM market_data.bars FINAL WHERE resolution = '1d' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Dips on trading days indicate per-symbol fetch gaps; flat weekend/holiday gaps are expected.

panels.title: Rows ingested per day by source

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(ingested_at) AS time, source, count() AS rows FROM market_data.bars WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at) GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time

panels.title: Freshness: most stale symbols (1d bars)

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol, max(timestamp) AS latest_bar, dateDiff('hour', max(timestamp), now()) AS hours_stale FROM market_data.bars WHERE resolution = '1d' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY hours_stale DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: After a daily ingest run every symbol should be < 72h stale (weekends included).

panels.title: Per-symbol bar counts (1d, lowest 25)

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol, count() AS bars, min(timestamp) AS first_bar, max(timestamp) AS last_bar FROM market_data.bars FINAL WHERE resolution = '1d' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY bars ASC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Symbols with materially fewer bars than the universe norm have fetch gaps, late listings, or delistings.

title: Data Quality -- Market Data Bars
